# Real-read check on computational mixtures of GIAB HG002 + HG003 (auto-generated by scripts/giab_mixture_check.py)

Illumina 60x reads of two real cell lines, thinned and added at a chosen HG003 fraction f; chr20:1-30 Mb; copy-neutral, purity 1. x uses the observed class VAFs, the mean depth and the beta-binomial rho fitted to the drawn counts. Not a tumour and not a physical mixture.

## Pooled summary

- Controls: 79 false splits in 240 single-class runs (33%); the x >= 1 screen (rho assumed 0.02) keeps 12 of them.
- Two-cluster cells with x < 1 (12 cells, 360 runs): 103 splits, the screen keeps 2.
- Two-cluster cells with x >= 1 (4 cells, 120 runs): 114 splits, the screen keeps 44.
- Frozen law versus observed split rate, all 16 cells: RMSE 0.179, bias (observed - predicted) -0.067.
- Frozen law versus observed split rate, x >= 0.6: RMSE 0.199, bias (observed - predicted) -0.152.
- Frozen law versus observed split rate, x < 0.6: RMSE 0.141, bias (observed - predicted) +0.075.
